# R5.27 — Rights, losses, quotas and recipient handoff validation

## Summary

Lands the §6.4 **rights, retention and recipient resource
ceiling** validation inside `hh-bundle` (the recipient-procedure
owner, beside `closure.rs`/`cards.rs`):
`admit_handoff(&Decoded, &HandoffPlan, now_ms) →
Result<HandoffReport, BundleError>` and
`sanitize_replace(&Decoded, member, new_bytes,
&SanitizeTransform) → Result<SanitizedItem, BundleError>` —
records-in/records-out; nothing executes or materializes.
`admit_handoff` walks `authority` → `metadata` → `grant` →
`quotas` → per-item rights/content/fetch/status → `departures`
verbatim: optional hosting and S3/account/provisioning locators
need `separate_authority`, commitment dates must exist and not
be future, access grants cap at ≤30 days/≤1 h links with no
write/delete/list, declared byte quotas hold against the scope
ceilings, unknown rights and lost bytes **withhold** the
affected item (never infer), restricted items refuse
`scope_mismatch` in public review (controlled closure is not
public closure), held-out solution/oracle/model-I/O roles
default restricted, released bytes are scanned for
`secret_material`/`sensitive_identifier`, fetch members re-admit
each location leg through `trust::admit`, and a bare delete
marker is `marker_not_deletion` — real departures emit
`rights-tombstone/1` and disable dependent procedures even
after earlier passes. Retention records
`effective_until = min(item expiry, review_before)` — shorter
rights override honestly. `sanitize_replace` requires
kind/version and a permitted mapping, scans the new bytes,
mints a **new** `hh-identity` address (changed bytes never
retain native hashes/R1), recalculates dependent claims
`{field, from, to}` and emits exact `{procedure,
native_identity, R0}` losses plus the `idp/1`-sealed
`rights-supersession/1`. No `hh handoff`/`hh sanitize` command
(C.4 — recipe/CLI owner is R5.28).

## What changed

- `crates/hh-bundle/src/rights.rs` — the two owner interfaces
  plus `HandoffScope`/`HandoffPlan`/`RightsRecord`/
  `RightsDecision`/`Departure`/`HandoffReport`/
  `SanitizeTransform`/`SanitizedItem` and the closed
  `rights::code` refusal set.
- `crates/hh-bundle/src/error.rs` — `BundleError::RightsRefused
  {code, detail}` variant (one typed refusal vocabulary).
- `crates/hh-bundle/src/lib.rs` — module + exports.
- `crates/hh-bundle/tests/r5_27.rs` — 18-case battery over an
  in-memory `Decoded` rig (manifest literal + `MemberBytes` —
  no store needed; handoff works on decoded artifacts).
- ADR-0405 (landing record), coverage dated note, BL-47 home,
  run ledger.

## Deviation (conspicuous)

**1,502 changed source/test lines vs the ≤650 trigger (~2.3×)**
— recorded Deviation, accepted per the scoped AMEND ruling
`963ff8f5` (`docs/build/planning/2026-11-03_R5.27-split-review.md`):
packet A1 carries no written contingency; §6.4 is one
conjunctive clause making `admit_handoff`/`sanitize_replace`
implementation interfaces, not documented seams (weaker than
R5.26's still-AMEND replay/fresh pair); AC-1/AC-2 span both
interfaces; leg (a) `admit_handoff` ~1,060 alone still exceeds
the trigger — non-curative.
